chunks: How many of the followers of the Books having once known the truth desire in their hearts, out of envy, to turn you into infidels again even after the truth has become clear to them! But you forbear and overlook till God fulfil His plan; and God has power over all things.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْکِتَابِ: People of the Book (Jews and Christians)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the envy of the People of the Book towards Muslims?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the internal envy (hasad) of the Jews as a spiritual defect rather than mere political rivalry, urging Muslims to respond with sabr (patience) and safh (forbearance) until divine decree is realized. This patience is not passive resignation but an active trust in Allah’s power, reflecting the broader Shia emphasis on enduring trials with dignity while awaiting the ultimate victory of truth.
